Contested escrow is a challengeable deposit: an identity locks 240 units for 15 epochs; any peer may dispute it in 3 epochs by staking 20.

A jury of 9 verifies in 2 epochs; confirmed forgery forfeits 80%, 25% to the challenger, and bars re-entry 12 epochs. The forge starts at its nadir, exposed by a crystal-clear trail.

Cost: 1,000 forgeries lock 240,000 units; at 30% detection, forfeiture is 57,600; honest deposits release 20 per clean epoch.
